newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIAN SHARES STALL AFTER 6-DAY WINNING STREAK.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIAN SHARES STALL AFTER 6-DAY WINNING STREAK.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index ran out of steam on Wednesday to end barely changed as profit-taking emerged after a string of solid daily gains.
"There was some profit-taking today and it was easy to feel nervousness on the market, as many shares have already reached very high levels," said Polona Cec, a trader at Factor Bank.
* The SBI index firmed 0.02 percent or 0.36 points to 1,611.42.
* Trading firm Kovinotehna was the most active, rising 1.40 percent to 580 tolars on volume of 5,676 shares.
* Petrol trader Istrabenz was the top gainer, jumping 3.30 percent to 3,410 tolars on volume of 2,525 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
